Use-case summary: IDE copilot for enterprise engineering teams + repo-aware code search. Goal: surface relevant snippets from monorepo (20M LOC) with context-aware completions.
Performance targets: median token generation latency < 40ms in-editor, tail p99 request-to-first-byte < 150ms; sustained throughput ~100 req/s during peak dev hours.
Retrieval architecture discussed: embeddings per file-chunk -> vector DB lookup -> hybrid reranker -> context window stitching. Interested in continuous re-embedding pipeline (commit hook trigger).
Chunking constraints: prefer repo-aware chunk sizes (function-level + README/owner metadata), preserve code boundaries, avoid cross-file semantic leakage.
Vector DB preferences: evaluating Milvus/Weaviate for on-prem; asked about Redwood-managed index vs. customer-owned vector node behind VPC.
Residency / compliance: EU data residency for EU engineering org; critical that embeddings never leave customer VPC for on-prem option.
Security asks: SSO (SAML), audit logging per token/request, KMS/HSM for key storage, retention controls for embeddings & logs, SCIM for user sync.
Model/versioning: need model pinning per workspace + safe autopromotion policies. Request: simple API to pin model hash and rollback to previous model quickly.
Streaming: low-latency streaming into VS Code extension is a must. POC will measure continuous streaming quality under batching windows vs immediate single-request mode.
POC status: infra spin-up complete (k8s on prem VM for vector DB), demo 2026-02-12 showed prototype completions; SE to run perf bench next week (Diego).
